message: The other day, I was chatting with my friend Ellen, who tends to panic at the slightest hint of a storm. As she fretted about the weather, I found myself smiling. I remember the time I helped her pack her go-bag—she was convinced she’d need three pairs of shoes for a weekend getaway! 😂 It’s funny how we all have our different styles of readiness. I reassured her that a little planning goes a long way, and sometimes it’s just about having the essentials ready. It’s comforting to know we can navigate the unexpected together, isn’t it?
